oakville_stretch.memo:
VERDICT: RESTRUCTURE

WHY
- B-20 stress test (qualification): GDS 39.9% and TDS 45.4% exceed 39%/44% limits at 6.19% qualifying rate (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core).
- Cash to close (closing): $19,875 shortfall ($239,875 needed vs $220,000 saved) (Cash to Close, Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite).
- Affordability (affordability): Max supported price $1,064,600 vs $1,100,000 contract (-$35,400) (Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite, Canada Housing Affordability Index).
- Document check (documents): Documented income $99,000 covers only 53.5% of stated $185,000 (Decision Ladder core, Doc Quest).
- Pre-underwriting readiness (readiness): Score 20/100 with 5 flags including high GDS/TDS and missing employment letter, NOA, down payment statement (Loan File Pre-Underwriting Check, Quiet Charges, Shoebox).

PATH TO YES
1. Lower the price to $1,067,000.
2. Raise the down payment to $255,500 (+$35,500).

CONDITIONS & RISKS
- Identity/watch-list screening not performed; broker must verify ID manually (MortgageLoanOps).
- Only B-lenders fit; expect higher rates/fees — disclose to client (MortgageLoanOps).
- Oakville semi benchmark $1,185,000 (-7.2% vs price); benchmarks indicative, not an appraisal (Benchmark Home Value).
- Renewal shock moderate: +1.0% rate at 5-year renewal raises payment ~10.5% to $4,727 (Renewal Shock Radar).
- APR disclosure 4.190% ($174,681 over term) required 2+ days before signing (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core).

NEXT ACTIONS FOR THE BROKER
1. Complete manual identity and watch-list verification before proceeding.
2. Collect missing documents: employment letter, NOA, down payment statement; reconcile the income gap.
3. Present the two restructuring options (price reduction or larger down payment) with updated stress-test results.
4. Disclose B-lender pricing, fees, and APR 4.190% cost-of-borrowing at least two business days before signing.
5. Advise client on $19,875 closing-cost gap; confirm source of funds if restructuring proceeds.

brampton_first_home.memo:
VERDICT: GO WITH CONDITIONS

WHY
- Screening: Not screened — no licensed list connected; a person must verify ID (MortgageLoanOps).
- Affordability: Max price $750,000 (GDS limit) vs purchase $725,000; $25,000 headroom; qualifying rate 6.24% (Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite / Canada Housing Affordability Index).
- B-20 qualification: GDS 35.0%, TDS 37.9% at 6.24% qualifying rate; passes (MortgageLoanOps / Decision Ladder core).
- Cross-check: 5/5 quantities agree across 6 engines (premium $28,350, qualifying rate 6.24%, base payment $4,116.83, LTT $10,975, LTT refund $4,000) (MortgageLoanOps, Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite, Loan File Pre-Underwriting Check, Cash to Close, Renewal Check, Renewal Radar).
- Cash to close: $64,643 needed; $72,000 savings leave $7,357 spare (Cash to Close / Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite).

PATH TO YES
Not needed

CONDITIONS & RISKS
- Identity & watch-list screening must be completed by a person before submission.
- Property price is 9.4% above Brampton town benchmark ($663,000); benchmark down 2.2% YoY and 18% over 5 years — confirm appraisal supports value.
- Renewal outlook: if rates rise 1.0 pp in 5 years, payment increases ~10.4% (moderate); share of income ~27% at renewal.
- Compliance: deliver APR 4.240% / cost of borrowing $141,320 disclosure ≥2 business days before signing; record suitability assessment; disclose conflicts and lender compensation (FSRA).

NEXT ACTIONS FOR THE BROKER
1. Complete identity and watch-list verification manually and document the result in the file.
2. Order or confirm an appraisal to support the $725,000 purchase price relative to the $663,000 benchmark.
3. Prepare and deliver the mortgage cost disclosure (APR 4.240%, $141,320 over 5 years) at least two business days before the client signs.
4. Confirm lender-specific guidelines for the 16 eligible lenders (6 big banks, 4 monolines, 6 credit unions) and select the best fit.
5. Ensure the client has the $64,643 cash to close (including $2,268 PST on premium) available on closing day.

pandemic_renewal_rbc.memo:
VERDICT: GO WITH CONDITIONS

WHY
- Identity & watch-list screening: NOT_SCREENED — no licensed list connected; a person must verify ID (MortgageLoanOps).
- Stress test at switch/refinance: PASS — stressed at 6.84% yields GDS 37.5% / TDS 42.5%; straight switch does not require re-stress-test per OSFI Nov 21, 2024 rule (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core).
- Property value & local prices: PASS — value basis $615,000 (purchase indexed to 2026-09); LTV 82.0%; estimated value -21.0% below purchase price (Benchmark Home Value).
- Exit cost & renewal economics: PASS — 1 month to maturity; priority 77.5 (call this week); payment rises 28.5% from $2,538 to $3,262; max saving vs worst offer $12,985 (Renewal Radar, Renewal Check, MortgageLoanOps).
- Cross-check across independent engines: PASS — 1/1 quantities agree across 2 engines; payment at renewal rate $3,269.81 confirmed (MortgageLoanOps, Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite, Loan File Pre-Underwriting Check, Cash to Close, Renewal Check, Renewal Radar).

PATH TO YES
Not needed

CONDITIONS & RISKS
- Identity and watch-list screening must be completed manually before any commitment.
- LTV 82% exceeds the 80% uninsured-switch threshold at many lenders; straight switch with current lender is unaffected, but alternative lender options may be limited.
- Property value estimated 21% below original purchase price ($780,000), reducing equity cushion.
- Payment shock: renewal at 4.84% increases payment ~28.5% ($724 [unverified]/month); keeping current payment would extend amortization ~12.7 years.
- APR disclosure 4.840% ($114,126 cost of borrowing over 5-year term) must be delivered ≥2 business days before signing (O. Reg. 191/08).

NEXT ACTIONS FOR THE BROKER
1. Complete manual identity and watch-list verification; document the outcome in the file.
2. Contact the current lender this week (priority 77.5) using the Renewal Radar retention script to request a rate match or improved offer.
3. Present the client with the payment-impact comparison (current vs. renewal vs. switch) and the equity/value gap (-21% vs purchase price).
4. Deliver the APR 4.840% / $114,126 cost-of-borrowing disclosure and all FSRA-required disclosures (conflicts, lender compensation, suitability record) at least 2 business days before signing.
5. Confirm the chosen lender’s live straight-switch policy for LTV >80% and document the client’s informed choice.

td_break_early.memo:
VERDICT: GO WITH CONDITIONS

WHY
- Qualification (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core): Stress test at 6.39% passes with GDS 31.6% and TDS 37.9%; OSFI rule since Nov 21, 2024 does not require re-stress-test for a straight switch if amount and amortization do not increase.
- Cross-check (MortgageLoanOps, Canadian Mortgage Calculator Suite, Loan File Pre-Underwriting Check, Cash to Close, Renewal Check, Renewal Radar): 2/2 key quantities agree across 5 engines — payment at renewal rate $3,673.12 and IRD penalty $17,013.33 (posted-minus-discount); TD exact method $16,363.73.
- Property (Benchmark Home Value): Stated value $1,150,000; LTV 60.9% against Toronto benchmark $908,000 (composite, Sep 2026).
- Market (Renewal Radar, Canada's Rate Cycle 2015-2026, Who Sets Canada's 5 Year Mortgage Rate?): File rate 5.29% is 0.80 points above BoC average 4.49% (Jul 2026); posted 5-year is 1.70 points above effective rates.
- Exit cost (Renewal Radar, Renewal Check, MortgageLoanOps): 21 months to maturity; IRD penalty ~$16,364 (TD exact); net cost to refinance $11,166 over remaining term after penalty and $1,500 closing costs; break-even 56 months; priority 9.6 (watch).
- Compliance (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core): APR 5.290%, cost of borrowing $158,714 over 5-year term; disclosures required before signing.

PATH TO YES
Not needed

CONDITIONS & RISKS
- Identity & watch-list screening not performed; no licensed list connected — a person must verify ID (MortgageLoanOps).
- No documents attached; all stated figures are unverified — request income documents (T4/NOA or pay stub + employment letter) (Decision Ladder core, Doc Quest).
- Exit cost priority 9.6 (watch): penalty ~$16,364 makes refinance uneconomic over 21 months left; net cost $11,166; break-even 56 months (Renewal Radar, Renewal Check).
- File rate 0.80 points above market average; client may qualify for better pricing (Renewal Radar, Canada's Rate Cycle).
- OSFI stress-test exemption applies to straight switches; lender policy may still require re-qualification (MortgageLoanOps).

NEXT ACTIONS FOR THE BROKER
1. Complete identity and watch-list screening manually; document the verification.
2. Collect and verify income documents (T4/NOA or recent pay stub plus employment letter) before proceeding.
3. Present the exit-cost analysis: $16,364 penalty, $11,166 net cost over 21 months, 56-month break-even; confirm client understands refinance is uneconomic at current rates.
4. Shop the file against the 21 lenders (6 Big Bank, 4 Monoline, 5 B-Lender, 6 Credit Union) to seek a rate below 5.29% — file rate is 0.80 points above the BoC average of 4.49%.
5. Prepare and deliver APR disclosure (5.290%, $158,714 cost of borrowing) at least 2 business days before signing; record suitability assessment; disclose any conflicts and lender compensation per FSRA.

VERDICT: GO WITH CONDITIONS

WHY
- Identity & watch-list screening: NOT_SCREENED — no licensed list connected; a person must verify ID (MortgageLoanOps).
- Document check: 0 documents attached; stated figures unverified (Decision Ladder core, Doc Quest).
- Commercial / private credit screen: Grade C (score 49); LTV 65%, DSCR 1.12, debt yield 9.54%, balloon $6.5M, exit value $10M, exit LTV 65%, breakeven value drop 35%, all-in yield 8.5%, take-out max loan $6,460,285, take-out gap -$39,715 (Private Credit Deal Screener, Decision Ladder core).

PATH TO YES
Not needed

CONDITIONS & RISKS
- Identity and watch-list screening must be completed manually before funding.
- Full income and property documentation (NOI verification, rent roll, environmental, appraisal) required to verify stated figures.
- Commercial grade C reflects sensitivity to NOI; any NOI shortfall degrades DSCR below 1.12 and widens the $39,715 take-out gap.
- Balloon risk: $6.5M balance due at maturity requires confirmed take-out capacity or equity cure.
- Rate risk: policy rate 2.25%, prime 4.45%, GoC 5y 3.55%; posted 5-year is 1.70 pts above effective rate (Renewal Radar, Canada's Rate Cycle 2015-2026, Who Sets Canada's 5 Year Mortgage Rate?).

NEXT ACTIONS FOR THE BROKER
1. Conduct manual identity and watch-list screening; document results in file.
2. Collect and verify all required documents: T4/NOA or pay stub plus employment letter, current rent roll, NOI statement, environmental report, and full appraisal.
3. Confirm take-out strategy: secure commitment for conventional refinancing at or below 6.0% or identify equity source to cover the $39,715 gap.
4. Provide FSRA disclosures: conflict of interest, lender compensation, mortgage cost disclosure, and suitability assessment record (MortgageLoanOps, Decision Ladder core).
5. Update file with verified figures and re-run commercial screen before submitting to lender.
